summary.zh: 澳大利亚境内订单满 80 澳元免标准配送费。
summary.en: Standard shipping is free for Australian orders of AUD 80 or more.

details.zh: 标准配送预计 3–7 个工作日。
details.en: Standard delivery is estimated at 3–7 business days.

details.zh: 未满 80 澳元的订单收取 8.90 澳元标准配送费。
details.en: Orders under AUD 80 have an AUD 8.90 standard shipping fee.

details.zh: 本毕业设计商城不处理真实订单或配送。
details.en: This graduation-project store does not process real orders or deliveries.

summary.zh: 未使用且包装完整的模拟商品可在 30 天内申请退换。
summary.en: Unused simulated products in original packaging may be returned within 30 days.

details.zh: 需要提供模拟订单编号和购买日期。
details.en: A simulated order number and purchase date are required.

details.zh: 因改变主意产生的退货运费由顾客承担。
details.en: Customers cover return shipping for change-of-mind returns.

details.zh: 故障商品按澳大利亚消费者保障原则处理。
details.en: Faulty products are handled in line with Australian consumer guarantees.

summary.zh: 每件商品的模拟保修期以商品详情中的月数为准。
summary.en: Each product's simulated warranty period is shown in its product details.

details.zh: 保修覆盖正常使用下的制造缺陷。
details.en: Warranty covers manufacturing defects under normal use.

details.zh: 意外损坏、误用和正常磨损不属于额外保修范围。
details.en: Accidental damage, misuse and normal wear are not covered by the additional warranty.

details.zh: 本政策不限制适用的法定消费者权利。
details.en: This policy does not limit applicable statutory consumer rights.

summary.zh: 当前演示仅在内存和浏览器会话中保存必要的聊天状态。
summary.en: The current demo keeps only necessary chat state in memory and the browser session.

details.zh: 请勿在聊天中输入密码、支付资料或其他敏感信息。
details.en: Do not enter passwords, payment details or other sensitive information in chat.

details.zh: 点击新对话会清除当前后端内存会话。
details.en: Starting a new conversation clears the current backend in-memory session.
